name: Cindy Koplar
text: I want to sincerely thank Jerry for taking the time to personally help me throughout the process. Your kindness, professionalism, and excellent customer service made the entire experience smooth and enjoyable. I truly appreciate your help and support. Thank you again!

name: Turner O’Dell
text: Bought a car from Maxim Auto and despite being located in Atlanta, Georgia the car was efficiently delivered and taken care of meticulously. Car came in the best condition I could ask for and the whole process felt very smooth and easy. Would buy again.

name: eran avi
text: The best service that I ever got when I bought a car. I'm so happy. I will definitely do all my purchases with this guy. Thank you Gary for everything. He changed all the fluid in the car before I got it. And also give me a second key without charging me. Thank you so much.

name: Michael
text: The nicest people i have ever worked with in a dealership. Special appreciation to Jerry ! We arrived on Saturday at 5pm and didn’t not expect somebody will show us the car since we were late. But we met Jerry on the parking lot, he was on his way home but he let us in and spent 2 hours showing us the car and trying to work on the other options. Along with Slava they have done a great job 👏🏻 They helped us to get rid of our car that had negative equity for the decent price! Highly recommend this dealership!

name: abby veith
text: I cannot recommend doing business with Jerry enough. He is a wonderful, honest, knowledgeable guy. I could not be happier with my purchase and he made the transaction so easy and accommodated my schedule and other needs. Thank you Jerry!

name: Luana Mihalka
text: Jerry is one in a billion. He truly cares about the people that come through his doors and he treats you like family. He is honest in the way he runs his business, completely fair, and truly a wonderful businessman. Jerry is also a very understanding person, so if there are any car troubles with the vehicle you purchased, he helps you out! If you need a car, definitely look into his business and consider him!

name: Kerry Zeman
text: Jerry is the most helpful and thorough professional I’ve ever dealt with. Jerry sold me a car for my teenage daughter. Great price, great service. 2 weeks later, her brakes were concerning, one back brake had locked up and the car was not safe to drive. I called Jerry, brought the car back, and he not only fixed the problem, but he replaced all 4 brake pads for us, because he said they would eventually need replacing. He charged nothing for this service, apologized for the trouble, and told us to call him if there were any more problems with the car. I am genuinely impressed with Jerry’s professionalism and integrity. Highly recommend this business.

name: Shimon Greenland
text: Very trustworthy, not some sleazy car-dealership. They care about you and want you to get the most out of your money. I cant describe enough how fortunate I am to have found this dealership.

name: Karina Muñoz. Q
text: Encontré una buena opción de auto para mi dia a día. Quedé muy satisfecha con la atención. Los recomiendo 👍✨️

name: William Zediker
text: Jerry made right on his errors with my car purchase so I can rate him as shown.

name: Tenzin Lochoe
text: If you’re in the market for a used car, do yourself a favor and give Jerry a chance before going anywhere else. Support a local family-owned business and work with someone who actually values his customers. Great communication, transparency, no unnecessary runaround, and a genuinely great buying experience. Jerry is definitely the guy to go to!

name: Luke E
text: Jerry at Maxim Autos made the whole process easy and stress-free. He was honest, responsive, and completely transparent with pricing—no games or hidden fees. Highly recommend him if you’re looking for a straightforward car-buying experience.

name: Courtney Sanchez
text: What a fabulous car buying experience! I’ve bought 1/2 dozen cars in my life - new and used, both from dealers and from independent sellers - and this was far and away the most efficient, friendly, zero-pressure purchase of all. I would have thought this level of service would only come with buying a car in the six figure price range!

name: Mario Vega
text: Veteran-Friendly — Highly Recommend! I recently purchased a Mazda CX-5 from here, and the experience was fantastic. Owner was super responsive, straightforward, and completely hassle-free. They made the entire process quick and stress-free. If you're looking for a smooth car-buying experience, this is the place to go

name: Frank Kupec
text: Maxim Autos offered and delivered a wonderful car buying experience, I’m very happy with my Volvo V60 cross country. There were a few normal minor wear issues as with any used car, but he stood by his claim of only selling quality cars and took care of them immediately for me! I’m very happy with the car, it drives and starts great. If I ever need to suggest a place to a friend, Jerry will definitely be expecting them and be more than happy to get them in the car of their needs with quality behind his sale and name! Thank you again Jerry for your amazing service and help with finding the right car for me in my budget!

name: Emma S
text: Very kind, organized, easy process to get the car I wanted. Would highly recommend and Jerry is extremely helpful. Very grateful!

name: Tabitha
text: Jerry was great to work with! I have driven my car 2 weeks and she drives just as great as the first day. I had a very great experience and I would recommend Maxim Autos to anyone. This is a family business you can trust!

name: Chris S.
text: Jerry was great. Very flexible, communicative and responsive to all questions. Went out of his way to drop the vehicle off. Will definitely recommend him to others.

name: Eduard Estopanan
text: Bought a Subaru Outback from Maxim Autos and had a great experience. Jerry was very helpful, let me take a full test drive, and answered all my questions. The contract process was smooth, with no add-ons or surprises—everything was clear and straightforward. Highly recommend.

name: Dima Tsipukh
text: Had a really good experience with Jerry, he’s super friendly, polite, and not pushy at all. Even helped us outside of regular hours. Totally recommend this dealership!

name: Jeremiah Johnson
text: I had an outstanding experience at Maxim Autos. Jerry made the entire car-buying process incredibly smooth and stress free. I'm thrilled with my Audi Q5 and will definitely be recommending them to any friends looking for a great deal. Thanks again Jerry!

name: David
text: Jerry was very polite and answered all my questions. I appreciate him not being pushy at all as well.

name: Ken
text: I bought an Audi Q5 for my mom from Jerry at Maxim Autos and couldn't be happier. No hidden fees, no pressure, very honest. The car is great — will definitely come back.

name: Kathi Cuevas
text: Maxim Autos is the best car dealership I have worked with. Jerry is kind, honest and trustworthy. He handles every aspect of the buying process. If you're looking for a car, start your search at Maxim Autos.

name: Jim
text: Hands down the most honest and straightforward car buying experience I've ever had. Totally pressure-free, prices set clearly, and he issued my plates on the spot — no trip to the DMV needed. Highly recommended.

name: Zoey Ph.
text: Smooth, straightforward experience with Jerry. He was so patient and not pushy, transparent about pricing and history. The process was quick. Overall, great customer service and fair pricing.

name: Andrew N
text: In a world where used car salesman have a bad reputation, Jerry exemplifies the opposite. He was trustworthy and honest about the car I bought. Further, when there was an issue, he worked with me to resolve it. I would buy a car from him anytime.

name: Melissa Federman
text: Just bought my son a used car through Maxim Autos. Jerry was a pleasure to work with. The whole process was very easy. The car was in incredible condition. Highly recommend!
